scope: Experimental opt-in V1 scenery contact and shared footprint storage; defaults off on every platform. Isolated branch, not integrated.
limitations: Cold shader preparation remains expensive; first-use times are observed warmup windows, not a controlled cache-flush study.
Map viewport costs are not gameplay FPS. GPU clocks/load vary.
Contact does not reproduce every terrain relief/track normal, wet specular term or shoreline vertex-light interpolation.
Broad animated camera, moving/rotated/scaled props and all-assets acceptance remain open.

integration.action: git apply --check only; no patch applied
